issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, but the solution implementation declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int. This mismatch between the specified return type (double) and the implemented return type (int) can confuse students about the expected method signature and leads to loss of fractional results due to integer division.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature and implementation match the UML by returning a double. Change the method declaration to public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and compute using floating-point division, e.g. return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); Ensure the template (and any reference solution) uses the same signature so students implement the method as specified in the problem statement.
